coverage_contract.rationale: Thin data carriers; lifecycle cleanup owned by QuestionObserver and DeleteOrphanNotifications job (covered in JOB-CMD/MDL-OBS lanes).
Schema verified during prior security/database audit and poll_votes invariant work; FK/index conventions uniform; no invalid-state combinations found beyond those already reported.
Small admin panel; resources backed by policies; no state machines or duplicated branching above threshold.
Arch test suite enforces structural conventions; dependencies audited via composer audit tooling.
Backed enums, presentational components, stateless validation rules, framework wiring, thin exceptions - boring local code already.

findings.title: Question visibility predicate hand-copied at ~15 sites
findings.summary: The 'is_ignored/is_reported false' pair (sometimes plus answer-not-null) was hand-copied across feed builders, Question relations, Livewire components, and recommendation services with no named owner.
findings.why_it_matters: Any future visibility rule (blocked accounts, poll expiry) must be applied at every site by hand; missing one yields feeds that disagree silently. Inside window-function feeds the predicate must apply to outer query AND subquery - drift drops whole threads.
findings.recommendation: Name the predicate once as a tappable scope class (App\Models\Scopes\WhereNotModerated with __invoke(Builder)) applied via ->tap(); compose with whereNotNull('answer') where semantics require answered-only visibility.
findings.remediation: Implemented: WhereNotModerated scope class created; adopted via ->tap() in 4 relations, 3 feed builders (5 sites incl. subqueries), Livewire Index/Edit, PeopleToFollowRecommendations. Trending keeps its freshness condition inline - no forced shape.
findings.verification_notes: tests/Unit/Feeds/* pin ignored/reported/unanswered exclusions; 267 tests green after adoption (Feeds + Livewire/Questions + Services suites).

findings.title: Untargeted question.ignore broadcast lets every mounted Show card mutate its own question
findings.summary: Questions\Show registers ignore/reported listeners only when not in index mode, and Edit broadcasts question.ignore without a target id - so every non-index Show component on the page runs ignore() against its own questionId.
findings.why_it_matters: On any page mixing pinned and thread cards (own profile), ignoring one question durably marks every visible received question is_ignored. On foreign profiles each card throws inside a batched update. Wrong-record durable-state mutation reachable by a normal click.

evidence.note: cards mount listeners-active Shows alongside pinned inIndex card

findings.recommendation: Register listeners unconditionally; guard handlers by identity (questionId parameter must match, null = direct wire:click call); drop the inIndex relay fork and dead showBorder state.
findings.remediation: Implemented in Show.php/Edit.php per audit spec; ShowTest listener map updated.

findings.title: Create composer shares one global session bucket for uploaded images across all instances
findings.summary: Draft content is persisted per draftKey, but uploaded-image tracking uses one unordered session list; posting form A deletes form B's referenced files ('unused' relative to A) and wipes B's tracking.
findings.why_it_matters: Multiple Create components mount simultaneously (feeds, profile, one per comment box). Cross-draft interference produces broken image markdown or orphaned storage files depending on ordering.

evidence.note: global push + containment delete + whole-key forget

findings.recommendation: Namespace the bucket by existing draft identity: key 'images.{draftKey}' threaded through uploadImages/deleteUnusedImages/cleanSession/getSessionImages; forget only the own key.
findings.remediation: Implemented exactly; CreateTest assertions updated to namespaced keys and a two-component regression test added (fails against old code).

findings.title: Avatar source selection policy split across five call sites with contradictory outcomes
findings.summary: For a connected, non-uploaded-avatar user, regeneration flips between GitHub and Gravatar sources depending on trigger: controllers thread literals ('github' on connect/delete, nothing on register/email-change/link-delete) while the job defaults to gravatar.
findings.why_it_matters: Same logical state yields different avatar sources by entry point; the destroy route's own flash copy already commits to github-first. Ownership of 'pick the right source' was undefined.
findings.recommendation: Derive once where the default lives: service ?? (github_username !== null ? 'github' : 'gravatar') in handle(); controllers stop threading literals.
findings.remediation: Implemented in job + both controller sites; Avatar::url guard unchanged.
findings.verification_notes: UpdateUserAvatarTest + GitHub UpdateTest: 13 passed, 1 skipped (Windows-only skip).

findings.title: Avatar generation marker conflates request/success/failure events; failure cancels pending supersession state
findings.summary: failed() wrote avatar_updated_at = null, erasing the ordering marker so any queued job with a non-null snapshot classified itself superseded until the next request; the column encodes three event meanings forcing a four-branch isSuperseded.
findings.why_it_matters: A stale job failing suppresses unrelated queued updates; same-second dispatches share a generation (second-granularity column).
findings.recommendation: Minimal: stop touching the marker in failed() (content reset stays). Full: opaque monotonic token column (ULID/counter) reducing isSuperseded to an inequality.
findings.remediation: Minimal variant implemented (marker preserved on failure). Monotonic-token migration recorded as future hardening (see F-2026-0013).
findings.verification_notes: Supersession tests green; failure-path test still asserts avatar content reset.

findings.title: IncrementViews deduplicates views with a lock-guarded shared cache list
findings.summary: One shared mutable array per (model, viewer) under an advisory lock: read-modify-write that loses dedup on crash, serializes concurrent runs, grows without bound over its TTL, and had an odd lock-timeout flow marked @codeCoverageIgnore.
findings.why_it_matters: State representation permits lost/contradictory dedup and unbounded growth; the mechanism can be replaced by an atomic primitive.
findings.recommendation: Atomic per-item flags: Cache::add("viewed:{model}:{id}:{viewer}", true, ttl) - SETNX semantics make 'true return = I own the count'; deletes lock/block/catch/finally/helper.
findings.remediation: Implemented; tests rewritten to per-flag assertions plus a double-dispatch no-double-count regression test.
findings.verification_notes: IncrementViewsTest: 7 passed (26 assertions). Trade-off noted: N cache round-trips per page vs 1 get+put - acceptable for Redis-style drivers.

findings.title: MetaData duplicates oEmbed host-dispatch blocks per provider
findings.summary: YouTube and Vimeo blocks in getData() are byte-for-byte copies differing only in host list and endpoint; provider knowledge lived in three places across two methods.
findings.why_it_matters: Adding a fourth oEmbed provider means pasting another block and hoping options match.
findings.recommendation: Class constant map endpoint => hosts iterated once through existing fetchOEmbed().
findings.remediation: Implemented as OEMBED_SERVICES const + single foreach.

findings.title: 'top-50-users' cache key written by two features with divergent definitions; request-scoped exclusion baked into global cache
findings.summary: Home\Users caches top-50 WITH its request-scoped verified-user exclusions under the same 24h key PeopleToFollowRecommendations writes WITHOUT exclusions; whichever warms first wins for the day.
findings.why_it_matters: Non-deterministic-by-write-order shared state: the rendered pool permanently misses <=2 ids for all users until expiry.
findings.recommendation: Cache holds canonical ranking; apply exclusions after read. Optionally bump key to v2 to shed stale entries at deploy.
findings.verification_notes: Two-line change; UsersTest pins caching semantics; new test should assert cached payload independent of $except.

findings.title: Latest-per-thread ROW_NUMBER subquery duplicated across feed builders
findings.summary: RecentQuestionsFeed and QuestionsFollowingFeed carry verbatim copies of the selectRaw ROW_NUMBER latest-per-thread construction (plus a variant in Livewire Questions\Index).
findings.why_it_matters: Thread-grouping rules drift silently if one copy changes; both feeds currently agree only by discipline.
findings.recommendation: Extract a shared builder helper (e.g., Question::scopeWhereLatestPerThread(Builder)) consumed by both feeds; Livewire copy has extra filters - adopt only the common core.
findings.verification_notes: Deferred: window-function SQL text must stay identical per site; existing feed tests pin behavior when attempted.

findings.title: PeopleToFollowRecommendations repeats the fill-remaining-slots idiom five times with two exclusion spellings
findings.summary: limit-count arithmetic + exclude-list threading re-implemented at five sites with two conventions, compensated by four zero-limit guards.
findings.why_it_matters: A sixth stage forgetting the spread reintroduces duplicates (masked downstream by array_unique at the cost of wrong slot counts/ordering).
findings.recommendation: Private fillRemaining(selectedIds, limit, callable $source) helper preserving laziness via closure sources; exact-ordering tests already pin behavior.
findings.verification_notes: Deferred: exclude-threading subtlety around genericFallback inner chain needs careful encoding; suite (PeopleToFollowRecommendationsTest) guards the refactor.

findings.title: Follow-state viewer closures duplicated across Followers/Following/Likes components
findings.summary: Three sibling modal components repeat equivalent 'does viewer follow / is followed by' closure logic for attribute decoration.
findings.why_it_matters: Relationship-direction bugs would need fixing thrice; a small shared helper removes the triplication without a new abstraction layer.
findings.recommendation: Extract one helper (trait or static) producing the follow/follower flag pairs; LikesTest pins both directions simultaneously.
findings.verification_notes: Deferred as P3 maintainability; existing four component suites assert exact attributes.

findings.title: poll_options.votes_count denormalized counter can drift from poll_votes rows under cascade deletes
findings.summary: votes_count duplicates a derivable count; FK cascades bypass Eloquent increments/decrements so drift is possible when votes disappear via cascade.
findings.why_it_matters: Poll percentages derive from the counter; drift misrepresents results. Mitigated by the unique(user_id, question_id) constraint and transactional vote() keeping normal paths exact.
findings.recommendation: Either drop the column and derive via withCount('votes'), or accept the counter with the existing transactional maintenance as the contract.
findings.verification_notes: Deferred: touches hot voting path and render percentages; PollVotingTest pins counter semantics end-to-end.
